conviction_note: The one lead that survived the search was a likely revenue and EPS beat, because management has guided below the prior quarter's actual and then beaten the top of its own range by more than 14% two quarters running. That pattern comes entirely from public guides and actuals, Morgan Stanley's 15 Sep preview puts its EPS 7% above consensus, the stock is up 20.6% in 20 days to a 52-week closing high, and the last beat of this kind (revenue 17% over consensus, beat and raise on 2026-06-25) closed -1.97%. So the fundamental read (+4.5% on revenue) is kept and the reaction is an honest 0. The pre-lessons draft had it at +1.0 / +0.5.
bar: FQ3 (Jun-Aug 2026) revenue consensus $18.79B, which two sources agree on: MarketBeat https://www.marketbeat.com/instant-alerts/upcoming-td-synnex-snx-to-announce-earnings-on-thursday-2026-09-17/ ($4.68 EPS) and Benzinga via https://www.webull.com/news/15593466831717376 ($4.64 EPS). The company guide is $18.2-19.0B revenue and $4.25-4.75 non-GAAP EPS (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001177394/000162828026045349/ex991-fy26q2pressrelease.htm), so consensus sits above the guide midpoint and EPS consensus is near the top of the range. The bar is sourced, so no cap applies.
positioning_check: Short interest is 1.65M shares, 2.24% of float, 2.91 days to cover (https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/snx/statistics/, read 2026-09-23, settlement date not shown). Ortex's preview (about 2026-09-15) says about 2% of free float, 0.28% borrow cost and no unusual put demand (https://ortex.news/articles/167940/snx-heads-into-q3-print-with-bulls-backing-hyve). This is not a crowded short. Skew is +0.24 vol points, i.e. balanced, and the put/call OI ratio is 0.21. The option market makes no directional statement, event-implied move is 4.8%, and the stock is at its 52-week closing high after +12% in 5 days and +20.6% in 20.

outside_window.finding: Amazon holds a warrant for 3,238,066 SNX shares (issued 2026-05-30; 215,871 vested at $0.01, the rest at $191.10 vesting on payment thresholds under commercial agreements). The 10-Q books it as a reduction of revenue as qualifying revenue is recognised, fair value about $116 per contingent share, so roughly $350M of contra-revenue in total, and none had been recognised through Q2. Q3 guidance assumed no material contribution from the newly onboarded Hyve customers, who ramp 'late FY26 or early FY27', and the Reno campus targets opening by year end. So the contra-revenue and the ramp land mainly after this window. The sign is ambiguous (volume up, reported margin down) and the market has had the 8-K since June.

searched_and_found_nothing: What moved the stock +12% in 5 days: no company-specific catalyst found. The move is a sector move (memory-stock rally 15-17 Sep, HPE +9% and SMCI +6% on 17 Sep, https://247wallst.com/investing/2026/09/17/ai-server-stocks-rally-as-the-hardware-bid-broadens-hewlett-packard-enterprise-jumps-9-super-micro-climbs-6-dell-rises-3/) plus UBS naming SNX a top pick with a $352 target on 2026-09-21 (https://finwire.io/news/stock-markets-news/amazon-stock-could-see-25-upside-palantir-stock-another-top-ai-pick-ubs-says). GuruFocus names no cause for the +5.0% on 09-21 (https://www.gurufocus.com/news/9090625/td-synnex-corp-snx-stock-up-50-but-gf-value-says-overvalued-gf-score-87100). All of it is wire copy.

Guide-conservatism pattern: FQ2 guide $16.1-16.9B against Q1 actual $17.2B, then FQ2 actual $19.6B; FQ3 guide $18.2-19.0B against Q2 actual $19.6B. Real, and it is why print_vs_bar is +4.5, but it is public and Morgan Stanley's 15 Sep note (https://www.bitget.com/news/detail/12560605837530) already models a strong beat and a raise. Dropped as a finding (see lessons_applied).

Peer read-through: Ingram Micro FQ2 (Apr-Jun) beat the top of its range on every metric and guided Q3 +7.5-10.7% (https://ir.ingrammicro.com/press-releases/detail/967/ingram-micro-reports-record-q2-2026-results-exceeding-the-high-end-of-guidance-across-all-financial-metrics-with-significant-operating-leverage). Points the same way as the consensus beat and is already public.

PC channel: IDC Q2 2026 shipments -4.9% but ASPs up, Apple +10.1% (Apple is 11% of SNX revenue, per the 10-Q). IDC's June forecast has Q4 units -20% YoY. All of it predates or is known at the Q2 print (https://www.idc.com/resource-center/blog/pc-market-enters-volatile-territory-as-memory-shortage-persists-through-2027/).

Memory pricing: TrendForce has server DRAM +13-18% QoQ in 3Q26, slower than 2Q26 (https://www.trendforce.com/presscenter/news/20260709-13140.html). This supports ASP-driven revenue but is a macro proxy, not a company number.

Hyve Nevada expansion (PR 2026-08-19, $500M+, 624k sq ft, ~3,000 jobs, Reno opening by year end, https://www.morningstar.com/news/pr-newswire/20260819la30185/hyve-solutions-selects-nevada-for-advanced-manufacturing-campuses-in-reno-and-north-las-vegas). Corroborates a FY27 ramp and implies start-up costs in FQ4. No document quantifies either, so the sign for the FQ4 guide is unresolved.

Financing: European AR securitisation of up to EUR650M (2026-06-26), inventory +46% and H1 FCF -$1.26B (10-Q). This is funding a corroborated Hyve and memory-inventory ramp (lesson 4), so it is a zero, not a negative. Old 1.75% notes and the Sep-2026 term loan were refinanced with 5.30% 2035 notes in 2025, which is known.

Customer concentration (10-Q): no customer above 10% of revenue in FQ2 FY26, against one at 11% a year earlier, despite Hyve billings +117%. The diversification is real but has no path to this print's reaction.

Insider activity: small director and Hyve-chair sales ($2.85M over 90 days, Hyve chair $2.68M on 2026-06-30 with option exercise, https://www.investing.com/news/insider-trading-news/td-synnexs-dennis-polk-hyve-solutions-chair-sells-268m-in-stock-93CH-4771504). No cluster, and no signal.
baseline_tension: Everything found agrees with the run-up and the balanced skew. The beat is expected by the sell side and bid into the stock (+20.6% in 20 days, at the 52-week high), and the last and larger beat-and-raise closed -1.97%, so the price already has all of this and nothing was found that cuts against it.
lessons_applied: Lesson 1 (a verified fact is not a predicted reaction): the one draft finding (+1.0, reported_quarter, guide-conservatism beat) is on the line this name did not pay for last time (revenue 17% over consensus with a raise, closed -1.97%), so the reaction was vetoed to 0 while print_vs_bar stays +4.5.

'What has worked' and 'Least priced is not most likely right': the finding rests on public guides and actuals plus a sell-side preview that already models the beat, not on a primary-document number no aggregator carries, so it was dropped rather than resized. Findings are now empty and expected_move is 0.

Lesson 6: bar checked against two agreeing estimate sources plus the company guide, so no cap was needed. The Amazon warrant contra-revenue and ramp resolve after the window and stay in outside_window at 0.
Lesson 4: the securitisation and working-capital build fund a corroborated ramp and were left at zero, the same as in the draft (no change).
Lesson 7: short interest was already looked up (2.2% of float, 2.9 DTC) and there is no negative finding for it to shrink (no change).
